name: Texture-AD-Benchmark
description: A benchmark for image-level and pixel-level anomaly detection on texture images. It measures how well models can detect and localize anomalous regions in texture datasets, supporting both image-level classification and pixelwise segmentation evaluation. The benchmark includes curated texture categories and anomalous examples to test robustness to subtle defects.
evaluation_method: AUROC (image-level) and pixel-level AUC / mean IoU for localization
reputation: Moderately used in the unsupervised anomaly-detection community as a texture-focused benchmark, cited by researchers working on AD for industrial textures.
